paper_title: MARBLE A Hard Benchmark for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning and Planning
caption: Performance of GPT-o4-mini on with binary or detailed feedback from solution validator. On , the performance will remain 0%.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the accuracy (%) of GPT-04-mini across five rounds of conversation when using two types of feedback from a solution validator: “Binary” (represented by an orange line with circular markers) and “Detailed” (represented by a blue line with circular markers). The x-axis, labeled “Round of Conversation,” ranges from 1 to 5 with integer tick marks, indicating discrete conversation rounds. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, ranges from 10% to 25% with major gridlines at 10, 15, 20, and 25. The “Binary” feedback line starts at approximately 10% in Round 1, rises to 17% in Round 2, 20% in Round 3, 21% in Round 4, and reaches 24% in Round 5. The “Detailed” feedback line also begins at 10% in Round 1, increases to 13% in Round 2, 21% in Round 3, 26% in Round 4, and peaks at 27% in Round 5. Both lines show a consistent upward trend, with the “Detailed” feedback consistently outperforming “Binary” feedback after Round 2. The plot title “CUBE-easy with Solution Validator” indicates the specific task and evaluation setup. The caption notes that on CUBE-hard, performance remains at 0%, though this is not depicted in the plot.
